svg.aria-label: The same ten training images before and after two independent augmentations. Intensity range 0–1; noise standard deviation 0.08; pixel masking probability 0.15. Digit headings are for interpretation and are not supplied to contrastive training. Data: E. Alpaydin, C. Kaynak, UCI, CC BY 4.0.
